Playbooks.definition: Product name of the Mattermost workflow product; stays in English as a product name.

playbook.definition: A reusable, configurable workflow definition (checklists, triggers, actions) that teams run repeatedly.

run.definition: A single execution of a playbook, with its own channel, tasks, and status updates; distinct from the verb 'to run a playbook'.

finish a run.definition: To mark a run as completed; a finished run can later be restarted.

resume a run.definition: To reopen a finished run and continue working on it.

checklist.definition: An ordered list of tasks within a playbook or run.

task.definition: A single checklist item that can be assigned, checked off, or skipped.

status update.definition: A periodic progress message posted for a run, optionally broadcast to other channels.

retrospective.definition: The review published after a run finishes, capturing learnings and metric values.

owner.definition: The run participant responsible for the run; there is exactly one owner at a time.

participant.definition: A person actively involved in a run, with permission to update tasks and post status updates.

follower.definition: A person who receives a run's status update notifications without being a participant.

trigger.definition: A condition (e.g. keywords posted, a user joining a channel) that starts an automatic playbook action.

action.definition: An automated step performed when a trigger fires, such as prompting to run a playbook or sending a webhook.

key metrics.definition: The measurements a playbook defines (duration, cost, integer values) recorded in each run's retrospective.

metric.definition: One measurable value tracked per run, e.g. time to resolve.

overdue.definition: Describes a status update or task whose due time has passed.

due date.definition: The date or time by which a task or status update is expected.

template.definition: A pre-built playbook, or a pre-filled text block (run name, summary, status update, retrospective) used when creating content.

timeline.definition: The chronological record of a run's events, such as status changes and task completions.

stakeholder.definition: A person interested in a run's progress who receives updates without working on tasks.

assignee.definition: The person a specific task is assigned to.

invitation.definition: The automatic adding of selected members to a run's channel when a run starts.

filter.definition: A control for narrowing lists of runs, playbooks, or tasks by criteria such as owner or status.

run channel.definition: The Mattermost channel linked to a run, where its updates and collaboration happen.

broadcast.definition: To automatically post a run's status updates to additional selected channels.

condition.definition: A rule based on attribute values that controls when certain tasks or sections apply to a run.

attribute.definition: A custom property field defined on a playbook and filled per run (text, select, date, etc.); distinct from user profile attributes.

section.definition: A named group of tasks within a checklist that can be skipped or duplicated as a unit.

run summary.definition: The editable description of a run shown in run details.
